note: Only cases and deaths from acute polio infections are included. Until 1983, the data includes all reported polio cases; from 1984, paralytic cases only. Case counts for 2024 and 2025, and the death count for 2025, are provisional.
title: Reported polio cases and deaths
subtitle: The reported figures include both [wild-](#dod:wild-poliovirus) and [vaccine-derived poliovirus](#dod:vaccine-derived-poliovirus) infections that occurred indigenously and as imported cases.
